card.name: Opioid warning: development of these behaviors
card.fires_on: The word "of" in the opioid boxed-warning sentence "reassess all patients receiving [drug] for the development of these behaviors and conditions." Weaker hits occur on nearby words in similar opioid risk-assessment or dosing sentences.
